overviewHtml:
Ganesh Himal view trek is one of the non touristic trekking regions of Nepal which offers a great scenario to its visitors. The marvelous view of the Ganesh Himal can be seen while doing this trekking. Situating at the central regions of Nepal, the Ganesh Himal is not so far from Kathmandu. While making our trek towards the Ganesh Himal we can get the superb view of the neighboring mountains like Annapurna, Langtang and Manaslu Mountains. Similarly, the trekking routes to the Ganesh Himal go all the way through some marvelous forest which is rich in both flora and fauna. The forests are rich is varieties of vegetations and flowers. Thus a beautiful smell of fresh flowers always used to blow at the forest of the Ganesh Himal regions. The trekking route of the Ganesh Himal passes through some of the most traditional Tamang and Gurung villages of Nepal. The traditional lifestyle and the culture of the Tamang and Gurung people living at this regions will always mesmerizes us and also provides us several information about the regions and their culture.

The Ganesh Himal view trekking will begins all the way from Kathmandu with the drive over to Trishuli and form Trishuli the way will goes passing some splendid villages and forest of the trekking regions. The mix cultured villages along with the dense forest of the trekking routes will makes our Ganesh Himal view trekking spectacular. For the best view of the Ganesh Himal; autumn and spring season will be best.

Nepal Unique Treks and Expedition is arranging the Ganesh Himal view trekking with the collaboration with the visitors. We at Nepal Unique Treks and Expedition is offering several types of services and facilities to the trekkers who wants to enjoy the beauty of the nature.

Outline Itinerary
Day 01: Arrival at Kathmandu (1350m) and then guided towards the hotel room at Kathmandu.

Day 02: Sightseeing tour at Kathmandu

Day 03: Kathmandu to Trishuli bazaar

Day 04: Trishuli bazaar to Deurali Bhanjyang (1700m)

Day 05: Deurali Bhanjyang to Bhaisi Kharka (2300m)

Day 06: Bhaisi Kharka to Kharani odar (2800m)

Day 07: Kharani Odar to Singla pass (4600m)

Day 08: Singla pass to Kharka (2500m)

Day 09: Kharka to Chalise (1800m)

Day 10: Chalise to Laba (2550m)

Day 11: Laba to Mongaythati (3700m)

Day 12: Mongaythati to Ghunchet (2100m)

Day 13: Ghunchet to Arughat bazaar.

Day 14: Arughat to Kathmandu driving for about 7 to 8 hours.

Day 15: Farewell and final departure towards your own home.
